extracted.name: Tangy chicory salad
extracted.description: Dress this chicory salad with sherry vinegar, honey and orange for a taste of sunshine in winter. It's ideal for a Christmas buffet served with ham
ingredient_lines: 2 tbsp toasted pumpkin seeds and 30g shaved parmesan (or vegetarian alternative), to serve
instruction_lines: Whisk together the vinegar, honey, orange zest and juice and olive oil. Season to taste, then set aside.
Thinly slice the bottom third of each chicory heart, then separate the leaves. Put in a bowl and mix with the salad dressing. To serve, scatter over the pumpkin seeds and parmesan shavings.
